identity: A desktop-style workspace contains small apps for browsing and changing files, using a shell, formatting text, scheduling events, and saving preferences.

scenarios.name: tree
scenarios.screen: A collapsed folder tree shows folder and file names in rows. No file is open, and no folder is loading.
scenarios.scene: The target file is visible on the first screen with its ancestor folders open; up to two other folders are open, and no file has been clicked.

arrangements.text: The folder tree runs vertically, with each child row indented beneath its parent.
The folder tree sits on the left, with a file preview area to its right when a file is opened.

scenarios.hint: Show a nested file tree with the exact target filename visible inside expanded folders and several distractor files. It is not selected yet.

scenarios.name: files
scenarios.screen: A file tree shows folders and files in rows, with folders initially collapsed. No name field, context menu, or Undo toast is open.
scenarios.scene: The target row is visible on the first screen with its ancestor folders open; for a rename or delete task, the target is selected.
never: Several files selected for a bulk operation.

arrangements.text: Folder and file rows run down one tree, with child rows indented beneath open folders.
The tree occupies the task area, and a context menu opens beside the selected row after a right click.

scenarios.name: move
scenarios.screen: A folder tree shows the file to move and collapsed folders leading to its destination. The file is in its original folder, and no drag is in progress.
scenarios.scene: The file is visible in its original location, with no drag in progress.
never: A file already floating under the pointer.
A file already outside the tree.

arrangements.text: The source file and destination folders occupy one vertical tree, with child rows indented beneath open folders.
The tree sits in a scrollable pane, and the file is dragged across its rows toward a folder that opens beneath the pointer.

scenarios.name: terminal
scenarios.screen: A shell shows a command prompt in the home directory with an empty input line. The virtual files and folders appear as text only after commands list them.
scenarios.scene: A startup transcript has navigated to the target folder and listed its contents, including the target file; the prompt is ready for another command.

arrangements.text: Command history runs above the current prompt, with the input line at the bottom.
Long file listings appear as aligned text rows in the history above the prompt.

scenarios.hint: Show a terminal with a shell prompt, current working directory and an ls-like listing including a file with the requested extension in the requested folder. No destructive command has been executed; all content is a fictional task UI.

scenarios.name: editor
scenarios.screen: A rich-text document contains a few paragraphs beneath a toolbar for text style, size, color, alignment, lists, and undo or redo. Its size and color menus are closed, and no text is selected.
scenarios.scene: The text to format is selected in the document; an undo task instead retains the accidental formatting changes.

arrangements.text: The formatting toolbar runs across the top of the document, with paragraphs stacked below it.
The toolbar's available buttons run above the document, with size and color options opening below their buttons.

scenarios.hint: Show editable text containing raven when requested, a formatting toolbar with italic, underline and text-color actions; the requested formatting remains unapplied.

scenarios.name: calendar
scenarios.screen: A day schedule shows half-hour rows across a full day, with existing events placed at their times. No new-event draft or creation form is open.
scenarios.scene: A new-event form is open for an unnamed one-hour draft at the top of the view; time selectors show the draft when present.
never: An event already saved for the requested name.

arrangements.text: Time labels run down the left of the day grid, with event blocks beside their time rows.
Start time and duration selectors sit beside the day grid, with event blocks aligned to its visible rows.
Time labels and events fill a fixed span of day rows, with no grid scrollbar.

scenarios.name: week
scenarios.screen: A week grid shows day columns, half-hour time rows, and existing event blocks at their scheduled times. No event is being dragged, and no Undo toast is visible.
scenarios.scene: The week grid is scrolled to the target event.
never: An event card outside its day column.

arrangements.text: Day columns run from left to right, with time labels down the side and events inside their day columns.
The day headers stay above the scrollable time grid, while event blocks line up with half-hour rows below.

scenarios.name: prefs
scenarios.screen: The workspace shows a closed Preferences dialog, accessible from a gear or title menu. Its settings tabs, controls, and Save button are not visible until the dialog opens.
scenarios.scene: The Preferences dialog is open on the tab containing the first requested setting, with its current values shown.
never: A Preferences dialog already containing unsaved changes.
Several Preferences dialogs open at once.
A detached settings page replacing the workspace.

arrangements.text: Inside the dialog, tabs run across the top, settings sit below them, and action buttons sit at the bottom.
Inside the dialog, tabs form a vertical list beside the settings, with action buttons along the bottom edge.
